title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has resigned
gist: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned after revelations of two extramarital affairs, including with a woman US authorities believe was a Chinese spy, with CFO Colette Kress named interim CEO. Nvidia shares fell about 10.2% pre-market, implying over $400B in lost market cap.

insights.claim: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned after revelations of two extramarital affairs, including a relationship with a woman US authorities believe was a Chinese spy and an affair with a senior Nvidia executive.
insights.speaker: Financial Times
insights.so_what: Key-person and governance shock at the central company of the AI trade; potential national-security scrutiny.
insights.locator: Nvidia chief executive Jensen Huang has resigned

insights.claim: Nvidia CFO Colette Kress will serve as interim chief executive following Jensen Huang's resignation.
insights.speaker: Financial Times
insights.so_what: Interim leadership adds uncertainty over strategy and a permanent CEO search.

insights.claim: Huang co-founded Nvidia in 1993 and over a 33-plus-year tenure turned it from a small video-game chip company into the linchpin of the global AI infrastructure boom, until recently the world's most valuable company.
insights.speaker: Financial Times
insights.so_what: Founder departure removes the face of AI hardware, a sentiment risk for the sector.

insights.claim: Nvidia shares fell 10.2 percent in pre-market trading after Huang's resignation, a move that would erase more than $400 billion in market capitalization.
insights.speaker: Financial Times
insights.so_what: Large single-name drawdown with spillover risk to AI-exposed indices.

insights.claim: Nvidia's semiconductors are integral to training and running AI systems such as OpenAI's ChatGPT and Anthropic's Claude, so turmoil at Nvidia plunges the chipmaker at the heart of the AI boom into crisis.
insights.speaker: Financial Times
insights.so_what: Leadership instability at the dominant AI chip supplier could ripple through the AI ecosystem.
insights.quote: plunging the chipmaker at the heart of the global AI boom into crisis.
insights.locator: Nvidia chief executive Jensen Huang has resigned
